# Configuration File Write Failure

If the configuration file (kc.toml) fails to write, the repository may not have the necessary configuration settings to operate, resulting in potential errors when trying to access its features.

- `knowledge_compiler/compiler/bootstrap.py` — `knowledge_compiler.compiler.bootstrap.write_config`
